summary: Retrieve a list of artists with optional track sub‑entities
description: Returns artists and, for each artist, a sub‑entity containing its tracks. Supports filtering, ordering and pagination. Includes the new 'audiodownload_allowed' boolean on tracks and notes that the 'audiodownload' field may be empty when downloads are not allowed.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The results formatting type.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200, 'all' limited to 200).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append '_asc' or '_desc' to specify direction; defaults are asc, except popularity fields default to desc.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, adds 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows ignoring limit/offset. Use sparingly due to performance impact.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more artist IDs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Exact artist name.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search artists by name using wildcard pattern.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter by artist joining date range (format yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: One or more track IDs to filter artists by associated tracks.

parameters.name: track_name
parameters.description: Filter by track name.

parameters.name: track_type
parameters.description: Select tracks of a certain type. Default returns only albumtrack.

parameters.name: album_datebetween
parameters.description: Filter albums by creation date range (yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd).

parameters.name: album_id
parameters.description: One or more album IDs.

parameters.name: album_name
parameters.description: Filter by album name.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: Desired cover image size in pixels.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: Audio format for the 'audio' field; defaults to mp31.

parameters.name: audiodlformat
parameters.description: Audio download format for the 'audiodownload' field; defaults to audioformat or mp32.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects, each containing standard artist fields and a 'tracks' sub‑entity.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata such as 'results_count' and optional 'results_fullcount' when fullcount=true.

notes: Each track object now includes a boolean 'audiodownload_allowed' indicating if download is permitted.
If 'audiodownload_allowed' is false, the 'audiodownload' field will be an empty string (as of April 2022).
Singles (track_type=single) have empty album_* fields; use 'track_type' to filter if needed.
The 'order' parameter defaults to ascending except popularity fields which always sort descending.
